technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions present but lack bullish confirmation; bearish price action, negative CMF, and absence of moving average support create high-risk environment unsuitable for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CPT shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 79 days present elevated risk.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (14/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absence of congressional buying and unavailable news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (432.88), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent CPI event create severely adverse macro conditions for real estate sector despite distant earnings.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI conditions (9 and 14) combined with fear-zone sentiment (14/100) and proximity to support level (121.74) create classic contrarian reversal setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Absence of bullish confirmation signals, negative CMF, price below all major moving averages, three black crows pattern, crisis-level VIX, unfavorable macro environment, and zero fundamental/institutional support make this a high-risk trap despite oversold technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI (9/14) and fear-zone sentiment (14/100) present contrarian setup, but lack of bullish confirmation, negative CMF, and price below all major moving averages eliminate conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis-level VIX (432.88), unfavorable macro environment, and zero institutional/fundamental support create high probability of continued downside despite technical oversold conditions.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, and risk agents all signal caution; only sentiment offers contrarian perspective
decision.portfolio_note: Existing CPT position plus 3 open Real Estate positions create sector concentration; avoid adding to exposure in adverse macro environment.
